elements.name: Flight
elements.desc: You have a flying speed of 50 feet. To use this speed, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor.

elements.name: Talons
elements.desc: You are proficient with your unarmed strikes, which deal 1d4 slashing damage on a hit.

elements.name: Aarakocra
elements.desc: Sequestered in high mountains atop tall trees, the aarakocra, sometimes called birdfolk, evoke fear and wonder. +2 Dexterity, +1 Wisdom, speed 25 ft.

elements.name: Genasi Subrace
elements.desc: Four major subraces of genasi are found among the worlds of D&D: air genasi, earth genasi, fire genasi, and water genasi.

elements.name: Genasi
elements.desc: Those who think of other planes at all consider them remote, distant realms, but planar influence can be felt throughout the world. +2 Constitution, speed 30 ft.

elements.name: Unending Breath
elements.desc: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you're not incapacitated.

elements.name: Mingle with the Wind
elements.desc: You can cast the levitate spell once with this trait, requiring no material components, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

elements.name: Air Genasi
elements.desc: As an air genasi, you are descended from the djinn. +1 Dexterity, plus Unending Breath and Mingle with the Wind.

elements.name: Earth Walk
elements.desc: You can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without expending extra movement.

elements.name: Merge with Stone
elements.desc: You can cast the pass without trace spell once with this trait, requiring no material components, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

elements.name: Earth Genasi
elements.desc: As an earth genasi, you are descended from the dao. +1 Strength, plus Earth Walk and Merge with Stone.

elements.name: Fire Resistance
elements.desc: You have resistance to fire damage.

elements.name: Reach to the Blaze
elements.desc: You know the produce flame cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the burning hands spell once with this trait as a 1st-level spell, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Fire Genasi
elements.desc: As a fire genasi, you have inherited the volatile mood and keen mind of the efreet. +1 Intelligence, Darkvision, Fire Resistance, and Reach to the Blaze.

elements.name: Acid Resistance
elements.desc: You have resistance to acid damage.

elements.name: Amphibious
elements.desc: You can breathe air and water.

elements.name: Swim
elements.desc: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

elements.name: Call to the Wave
elements.desc: You know the shape water cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the create or destroy water spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Water Genasi
elements.desc: The lapping of waves, the spray of sea foam on the wind, the ocean depths — all of these things call to your heart. +1 Wisdom, Acid Resistance, Amphibious, Swim, and Call to the Wave.
